svg.title: Text models: TTFAT P50 and P95
svg.desc: Text models ranked by descending pass rate and ascending median time to first answer token. A solid dot shows TTFAT P50 and an open dot shows P95 on a logarithmic latency axis. Dark dots identify speed and accuracy efficient rows.
svg.text: Text models: TTFAT P50 and P95
Rows ranked by pass rate, then P50 · solid dot P50 · open dot P95 · logarithmic latency scale
